capabilities: Render D2 diagrams from d2 code blocks
Configure layout engine and options via d2-config blocks
Set sketch options in plugin settings
extras: Unofficial and not affiliated with or endorsed by Terrastruct; the TALA layout engine is not supported and sketch options can only be configured in settings.
intentEvidence: Unlike the official D2 plugin, this plugin uses the official D2 JavaScript library to render diagrams entirely in-process
problem: The official D2 plugin requires a separate D2 installation, so diagram rendering fails or needs setup on machines without the CLI.

relations.evidence: Unlike the official D2 plugin, this plugin uses the official D2 JavaScript library

summary: Standalone renderer that displays D2 diagrams from d2 code blocks in notes without installing the D2 CLI, using the D2 JavaScript library in-process.
